testsuite.name: gspa.predictor.PipelineDispatchSpec

testcase.name: genomic-region sidecars run as genome tools on nucleotide input; statuses distinguish unavailable / failed / zero / success
a sidecar that exits 0 but writes no TSV (wrapped tool failed) is FAILED, not zero regions
a region tool without its database is UNAVAILABLE with the reason, and never executed
region tools refuse protein-only input rather than scanning protein FASTA
InterProScan honors the domain thread budget
HMMER database is wired from the pipeline into the registered predictor
